_note: Third sample, sized larger (14 tasks) to tighten the completion-rate estimate from samples 1-2 (5/15 so far). Mostly READ (WebBench's largest category) across major e-commerce/media/travel sites not touched before, deliberately including several with known real-world bot-protection reputations (Amazon, Best Buy) to keep the sample honest rather than cherry-picked toward easy targets. One CREATE task (add-to-cart on AliExpress) chosen specifically because it's safe/reversible and needs no login or real personal data -- WRITE-category tasks requiring login or submitting real data to a business (newsletter signups, account creation) were deliberately excluded on ethical/scope grounds, not because they'd be hard. IDs match the dataset's own row IDs.
